plans.name: Self-service recording
plans.detail: For returning users after an induction. Preset cameras, microphones and one recorded programme file.

plans.name: With a technician
plans.detail: A technician runs sound and camera switching. Take away the switched HD video and an audio copy of the mix.

plans.name: Edited episode
plans.detail: Technician-led recording, a finished edit up to 30 minutes, your supplied intro and outro, and one revision.

plans.name: Go live
plans.detail: One technical rehearsal, an operator for one live destination, and a local replay of the broadcast.

plans.name: Custom production
plans.detail: DJ performances, filming blocks and bespoke deliverables are individually quoted.
